name: agent-memory
description: Team memory for Claude Code: search, add, edit and delete memory through the memory MCP, save every turn to the agent's raw history (L0), and load the agent's profile and scenes at session start.

memory_url.title: Memory server URL
memory_url.description: Base URL of the memory server, without /mcp. Production (WAIP): https://weaverai-api.platform.weaversoft.io/api/mcp-proxy/memory-mcp. Local stack: http://localhost:8097.

memory_key.title: Your memory key (local server only)
memory_key.description: Leave empty in production: through the WAIP MCP proxy, Agent Memory knows who you are from your WAIP token. Only a local server needs your sk-mem key (WeaverAI Memory Fabric panel, API Key page).

agent_id.title: Agent ID (optional)
agent_id.description: Which of your agents to use. Leave empty if you own only one agent.

platform_token.title: WAIP token
platform_token.description: Your own WAIP token from the memory-mcp entry's Connection tab in the WAIP MCP store. It tells Agent Memory who you are. For a local server, enter local.
